lines.en: The sand is hot; my claws are not.
My tail drags a long furrow.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，量这片荒原。
lines.en: Step by step, I measure this badland.
The grass parts; I pass.
Walking fast makes me pant; I am in no hurry.
This savanna is familiar ground.
My tongue scouts ahead, tasting the wind.
The stones are sharp; I go around.
My shadow presses over the grass first.
There is shade behind the dune.
Each heavy step leaves the ground remembering me.
I shuffle along the game trail.
The sun warms my back; perfect.
I lie still; I can do it all day.
A low rumble rolls in my throat.
My tongue flicks in and out, tasting the air.
A bird calls far off; I ignore it.
My hide is thick; the wind cannot pierce it.
This stone has drunk its fill of heat.
I close my eyes; my ears stay awake.
The badlands are empty; just as I like.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨爪子，没别的事。
lines.en: I sharpen my claws; nothing else to do.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，虫声就大了。
lines.en: My breathing slows; the insects grow loud.

lines.zh: 我记得上一次下雨的味道。
lines.en: I remember the smell of the last rain.
The old scars on my hide no longer ache.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西，我还要再晒会儿。
lines.en: The sun is sinking; I will bask a while longer.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，已经很久了。
lines.en: You have stood there a long time.

lines.zh: 我一眨不眨，你最好也别动。
lines.en: I do not blink; you had best not move either.
Your shadow lies inside my mouth.
I lift my head only to judge the distance.
You smell of cooked meat.

lines.zh: 我盯你，是因为你先盯我。
lines.en: I stare because you stared first.
Do not reach your hand this way.

lines.zh: 你的腿比我短，跑不过我。
lines.en: Your legs are shorter; you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰上的水袋了。
lines.en: I see the waterskin at your waist.
You turn your back to me; bold.
My eyes wait for you to blink.
You stepped back half a pace; noted.

lines.zh: 皮厚，你只划开一道白痕。
lines.en: My hide is thick; you only left a white mark.
I grunt once and do not retreat.
That landed on an old scar.
My tail slams the ground and raises sand.
Pain makes me slower, and steadier.

lines.zh: 你把我的鳞片削掉一片。
lines.en: You chipped off one of my scales.
I turn to face you squarely.
Blood soaks into the sand and is gone.
I do not cry pain; I cry hunger.
Enough sun and the wound closes itself.
Leave the meat; take yourself away.
That smell comes from your pack.
I do not catch what is thrown.
You wave meat at me as if I were a pup.

lines.zh: 生肉比熟肉更对我的牙。
lines.en: Raw meat suits my teeth better than cooked.
I approach slowly; make no sound.
One piece is not enough; I am large.
Set the meat on the stone.
I smell the sweat on your palm.

lines.zh: 吃完这块，我或许放你走。
lines.en: After this piece, I might let you go.
You bump into me as into a wall.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你的膝盖。
lines.en: My tail sweeps your knee.
Do not push; my hide snags you.
You stepped on my claw.
I shifted aside to let you pass.
That little strength will not move me.
Bone knocks bone with a dull sound.
I smell salt on your sleeve.
Stand clear; my tail still swings.
You rested your hand on my back.
She digs the sand and buries the eggs.

lines.zh: 我不守巢，我只守这片地。
lines.en: I do not guard the nest, only this ground.

lines.zh: 雄性之间，我们会直立摔跤。
lines.en: We males wrestle upright.
Her hide is one shade darker than mine.

lines.zh: 这一季，荒原上都是脚印。
lines.en: This season, the badlands are full of tracks.
I circled her three times.
The shells are soft; they must be buried deep.
The young can run the moment they hatch.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的响声变了调。
lines.en: The rumble in my throat changed pitch.

lines.zh: 我们把巢选在太阳晒到的地方。
lines.en: We chose a nest where the sun reaches.
I drag the meat behind the bushes.

lines.zh: 这具尸体太大，我拖着走。
lines.en: This carcass is too large; I drag it along.
I bite the bone and shake it twice.
I smell your ration sack.
I hold the egg in my mouth without cracking it.
I will dry this hide in the sun.
I pick things up with my mouth, not my claws.
Whatever falls to the ground belongs to my stomach.
I cannot drag a whole cow.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的东西，我挖出来。
lines.en: I dig up what the sand has buried.
That chicken is pecking at the sand.
The rabbit's ear twitched.
The boar has short legs; it cannot run fast.
A snake slipped into a rock crevice.
The lizard is small, barely a mouthful.
A horse has strayed from the herd.
I smell young flesh.
That bird cannot fly high.
The target dozes in the shade.
I lower my head and creep closer.
It still has its head down; good chance.
I choose the slowest one.

lines.zh: 气味顺着风送到我鼻子里。
lines.en: The scent comes to my nostrils on the wind.
I have waited long for this bite.
I stare at you; you stare back.
The longer you stand, the more certain I am.

lines.zh: 我的舌头记住了你的味道。
lines.en: My tongue has memorized your taste.
You go left; my head follows left.
I do not chase; I wait for you to come.
The sand is soft; your steps are loud.
My tail blocks the path.
You are panting; I hear it.
You need only three more steps.
I raise my head slowly, not in friendship.
You tightened your grip on the sword; I saw.
I do not roar; roaring would scare you off.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味越来越近。
lines.en: The smell of your iron draws nearer.

lines.zh: 这片沙地，只留一个脚印。
lines.en: Only one set of tracks will remain on this sand.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，沙子从我背上滑。
lines.en: I lift a foot; sand slides off my back.
I bite down and do not let go.
Claws pin it; then the teeth go in.
One sweep of my tail and you stagger.
This bite will make bone sound.
I do not tear; I swallow whole.
You dodged the first strike.
My bite is like a blunt pair of pincers.
A bite at the ankle and you go down.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把猎物摔在地上。
lines.en: I shake my head and slam the prey down.
The smell of blood makes me hungrier.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的肩上，皮太厚。
lines.en: You cut my shoulder; the hide is too thick.
I fall back half a step, then press in again.
Do not block with your hand; it will be bitten too.
This meal will last me three days of sleep.
I push up out of the red sand.
This badland belongs to me first.
The sun strikes my back; I wake.
I shake the dirt off my back.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的风带来了肉味。
lines.en: The savanna wind carries the smell of meat.
When I broke the shell, the sand was hot.
The jungle's edge can hold me too.
I was bigger than a dog at birth.
No other monitor claims this ground.
First I find a stone to bask on.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气在我脚下抖。
lines.en: The desert heat shimmers under my feet.
I walk out from behind the shrubs.

lines.zh: 你最好别在我刚醒时靠近。
lines.en: Best not approach just as I wake.
This is my first mouthful of air.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，先晒背。
lines.en: I squeeze from a rock gap and bask first.

lines.zh: 这片恶地今天多了一串爪印。
lines.en: The badlands have a new set of tracks.
Fire catches my back; I roll in the sand.

lines.zh: 从岩台上摔下，骨头没事。
lines.en: I fell from the rock ledge; no bones broke.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我猛地抬头。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils; I jerk my head up.
The blast flips me; my hide does not split.

lines.zh: 箭扎进皮里，只进了半寸。
lines.en: The arrow lodges half an inch into my hide.
Cold light seeps in; my scales go numb.
Hunger has made even my tongue lazy.
Lightning strikes the stone; my ears ring.
The ground is gone, and so is the sand.
